buffs.name: Mora's Agony
buffs.effect: Summons a field of writhing tentacles that lasts 30 seconds and poisons foes who enter it.
buffs.notes: Acquired from the Black Book The Hidden Twilight.

buffs.name: Mora's Boon
buffs.effect: Fully restores your Health, Magicka and Stamina.
buffs.notes: Acquired from the Black Book The Hidden Twilight. The description is not accurate, though. This power restores 1000 points to each of your attributes, which may not "fully restore" them for high-level characters.

buffs.name: Mora's Grasp
buffs.effect: Targets are frozen between Oblivion and Tamriel for 30 seconds, and immune to all damage.
buffs.notes: Acquired from the Black Book The Hidden Twilight.

buffs.name: Nightingale Strife
buffs.effect: Instantly absorb 100 points of Health from the target.
buffs.notes: Reward from Darkness Returns.

buffs.name: Nightingale Subterfuge
buffs.effect: People and creatures in the spell's area of effect will attack anyone nearby for 30 seconds.
buffs.notes: Reward from Darkness Returns.

buffs.name: Secret of Arcana
buffs.effect: Spells cost no magicka for 30 seconds.
buffs.notes: Acquired from the Black Book Filament and Filigree. While under the effect of this power, if you begin casting a spell that consumes magicka over time (such as Telekinesis), that spell will remain free of magicka cost for as long as it is active.

buffs.name: Secret of Protection
buffs.effect: You take half damage for 30 seconds.
buffs.notes: Acquired from the Black Book Filament and Filigree.

buffs.name: Secret of Strength
buffs.effect: Power attacks cost no stamina for 30 seconds.
buffs.notes: Acquired from the Black Book Filament and Filigree.

buffs.name: Shadowcloak of Nocturnal
buffs.effect: For 120 seconds you automatically become invisible while sneaking.
buffs.notes: Reward from Darkness Returns. • Within the duration, any actions done while sneaking will turn you visible but allow you to toggle back into sneak to turn invisible again. After this duration, the player may enter invisibility/visibility at will but the effect

buffs.name: Summon Karstaag
buffs.effect: Summons Karstaag to fight for you for 120 seconds. You may only use this ability 3 times, and only while outdoors.
buffs.notes: Reward from the quest Summoning Karstaag. Unlike most Greater Powers, you may use this ability three times while outdoors and then never again.

buffs.name: Summon Spectral Assassin
buffs.effect: Summons the ghost of the legendary assassin Lucien Lachance to fight by your side, until he's defeated.
buffs.notes: Reward from Bound Until Death. Is cast like a spell, as opposed to the power/shout button.

buffs.name: Bardic Knowledge
buffs.effect: Summons a spectral drum that plays for 300 seconds, improving Stamina Regen for you and nearby allies.
buffs.notes: Acquired from the Black Book Untold Legends.

buffs.name: Black Market
buffs.effect: Summons a Dremora merchant for 15 seconds.
buffs.notes: Acquired from the Black Book Untold Legends. Has 2000 gold, restocks every two days. Affected by the Fence speech perk.

buffs.name: Bound Quiver
buffs.effect: Creates a magic quiver for 120 seconds.
buffs.notes: Acquired from the Arcane Archer Pack's Spell Tome: Bound Quiver. Has a base cost of 206 magicka to cast, with Adept Conjuration halving the cost. Grants no experience. With the Mystic Binding perk, quiver changes to Mystic Quiver, for 120 secs.

buffs.name: Breath of Nchuak
buffs.effect: Draws upon stamina to release a scorching blast of steam that deals 15 points of damage per second.
buffs.notes: Acquired by wearing the Visage of Mzund.

buffs.name: Frostmoon Instinct
buffs.effect: Slows time for 20 seconds.
buffs.notes: Activated when entering beast form while wearing the Ring of Instinct.

buffs.name: Howl of the Pack
buffs.effect: Summons two spectral pack members to aid in combat.
buffs.notes: Acquired by praying to the Totem of Brotherhood during the Totems of Hircine Quest.

buffs.name: Secret Servant
buffs.effect: Summons a Dremora butler for 15 seconds to carry your excess items.
buffs.notes: Acquired from the Black Book Untold Legends. Can carry up to 148 units in weight.

buffs.name: Telekinesis Arrows
buffs.effect: Releases suspended Telekinesis Arrows.
buffs.notes: Found on Urag gro-Shub’s desk in the Arcaneum at the College of Winterhold.

buffs.name: Additional Werewolf Transformations
buffs.effect: Additional Werewolf Transformations
buffs.notes: Acquired from equipping the cleansed Ring of Hircine. Lifts the one-time daily limit of the "Beast Form" power, allowing werewolves to perform additional transformations.

buffs.name: Agent of Dibella
buffs.effect: You do more combat damage to the opposite sex. • 10% more melee damage
buffs.notes: Reward from The Heart of Dibella.

buffs.name: Agent of Mara
buffs.effect: 15% Resist Magic.
buffs.notes: Reward from The Book of Love. Listed in Active Effects menu under "Resist Magic".

buffs.name: Ahzidal's Genius
buffs.effect: Increases your Enchanting skill by 10 points.
buffs.notes: Acquired from wearing any four of the seven relics of Ahzidal: Ahzidal's mask, Ahzidal's Helm of Vision, Ahzidal's Armor of Retribution, Ahzidal's Gauntlets of Warding, Ahzidal's Boots of Waterwalking, Ahzidal's Ring of Necromancy, or Ahzidal's Ring of Arcana.

buffs.name: Ancient Knowledge
buffs.effect: Knowledge gained from the Lexicon gives you a 25% bonus when wearing Dwarven Armor and Blacksmithing increases 15% faster.
buffs.notes: Reward from Unfathomable Depths. (See Bugs.)

buffs.name: Boethiah's Blessing
buffs.effect: You are able to move more quietly, and opponents that get too close take 5 points poison damage per second.
buffs.notes: Added by wearing the Ebony Mail.

buffs.name: Companion's Insight
buffs.effect: Your attacks, shouts, and destruction spells do no damage to your followers when in combat.
buffs.notes: Acquired from the Black Book The Winds of Change.
quests: Black Book: The Winds of Change

buffs.name: Dragon Infusion
buffs.effect: Dragons do 25% less melee damage.
buffs.notes: Effect from Esbern's Potion.

buffs.name: Dragonborn Flame
buffs.effect: When your Fire Breath Shout kills an enemy, a fire wyrm emerges from their corpse to fight for you for 60 seconds.
buffs.notes: Acquired from the Black Book Epistolary Acumen.

buffs.name: Dragonborn Force
buffs.effect: Your Unrelenting Force shout does more damage and using all three words may disintegrate enemies.
buffs.notes: Acquired from the Black Book Epistolary Acumen.

buffs.name: Dragonborn Frost
buffs.effect: Your Frost Breath Shout encases foes in ice for 15 seconds.
buffs.notes: Acquired from the Black Book Epistolary Acumen.

buffs.name: Eternal Spirit
buffs.effect: While Ethereal, you recover health 25% faster.
buffs.notes: Meditation on the Words of Power - choose Feim. Eternal Spirit is only visible on the Active Effects menu when the character is Ethereal. • Cannot simultaneously have this and the Force Without Effort or The Fire Within abilities.
buffs.group: Meditations on the Words of Power
buffs.source: Meditations on the Words of Power

buffs.name: Father's Love
buffs.effect: Healing spells and potions restore 25% more health for 8 hours.
buffs.notes: Acquired when sleeping in the same location as your adopted child/children if you are male and not a Werewolf.

buffs.name: The Fire Within
buffs.effect: Fire Breath shout deals 25% more damage.
buffs.notes: Meditation on the Words of Power - choose Yol. • Cannot simultaneously have this and the Eternal Spirit or Force Without Effort abilities.
buffs.group: Meditations on the Words of Power
buffs.source: Meditations on the Words of Power

buffs.name: Force Without Effort
buffs.effect: You stagger 25% less and foes stagger 25% more.
buffs.notes: Meditation on the Words of Power - choose Fus. • Cannot simultaneously have this and the Eternal Spirit or The Fire Within abilities.
buffs.group: Meditations on the Words of Power
buffs.source: Meditations on the Words of Power

buffs.name: Lover's Comfort
buffs.effect: All skills improve 15% faster for 8 hours.
buffs.notes: Acquired when sleeping in a place where your spouse is also present. Not obtained if you have the Lover's Stone active or are a Werewolf.

buffs.name: Lover's Insight
buffs.effect: Do 10% more damage and get 10% better prices from people of the opposite sex.
buffs.notes: Acquired from the Black Book The Winds of Change.
quests: Black Book: The Winds of Change

buffs.name: Mother's Love
buffs.effect: Healing spells and potions restore 25% more health for 8 hours.
buffs.notes: Acquired when sleeping in the same location as your adopted child/children if you are female and not a Werewolf.

buffs.name: Neloth's Health Boost
buffs.effect: Neloth's 25 point health boost. Remains until submerged in water after which you lose 25 points of health until you return to Neloth.
buffs.notes: Acquired during the quest Experimental Subject.

buffs.name: Nightingale Armor Full Set
buffs.effect: Increases Armor Rating by 25 points.
buffs.notes: Reward from Trinity Restored; only effective if wearing all Nightingale Armor. Listed in Active Effects menu under "Fortify Armor Rating".

buffs.name: Prowler's Profit
buffs.effect: Anywhere gems might be found, members of the Thieves Guild always seem to find a few more.
buffs.notes: Reward from No Stone Unturned. Grants a greater chance of finding additional gems in chests. For details, see Gems.

buffs.name: Rested
buffs.effect: All skills improve 5% faster for 8 hours.
buffs.notes: Acquired when sleeping in a normal bed, i.e neither in a player home nor a rented bed in an inn nor with the player's spouse. Not obtained by players who have the Lover's Stone active or are a Werewolf.

buffs.name: Sailor's Repose
buffs.effect: Healing spells cure 10% more.
buffs.notes: Reward from Frostflow Abyss.

buffs.name: Scholar's Insight
buffs.effect: Reading Skill Books gives you an extra Skill Point.
buffs.notes: Acquired from the Black Book The Winds of Change. • Note that while books you have not read grant you two skill points, books you have already read will not grant you an extra skill point if you read them again, so you'll get the most benefit from this if you
quests: Black Book: The Winds of Change

buffs.name: Seeker of Might
buffs.effect: Combat skills are all 10% more effective.
buffs.notes: Acquired from the Black Book The Sallow Regent. • Specifically multiplies physical damage with one-handed weapons, two-handed weapons, bows, and crossbows, damage blocked with shields and weapons, weapon and armor tempering, and the armor rating of non-shield

buffs.name: Seeker of Shadows
buffs.effect: Stealth skills are all 10% more effective.
buffs.notes: Acquired from the Black Book The Sallow Regent. • Specifically multiplies the size of locks' sweet spot, player alchemy effectiveness, and item sell prices by 1.1, item buy prices by 0.91, adds 10% to pickpocket chance, and reduces player detection while crouc

buffs.name: Seeker of Sorcery
buffs.effect: All spells cost 10% less magicka. Enchantments are 10% more powerful.
buffs.notes: Acquired from the Black Book The Sallow Regent. • Note that the 10% enchanting bonus does not appear in the dialogue box presented for 'Activate Seeker of Sorcery'. It only shows up in the Active Effects section of the Magic menu. • The 10% cost reduction stac

buffs.name: Shrouded Armor Full Set
buffs.effect: Increases Armor Rating by 25 points.
buffs.notes: This bonus applies for any combination of Dark Brotherhood armor, namely any combination of four pieces of Ancient Shrouded, Shrouded, or Worn Shrouded armor; Tumblerbane Gloves also qualify.

buffs.name: Sinderion's Serendipity
buffs.effect: There is a 25% chance of creating a duplicate potion when using your alchemy skill.
buffs.notes: Reward from A Return To Your Roots. The ability is independent of the book The Nirnroot Missive, and therefore remains active even if you remove the book from your inventory.

buffs.name: Turn of the Seasons
buffs.effect: Barter prices are 10% better when raining. With a full set of Light Armor equipped, stamina regenerates 5% faster in clear or clement weather. 10% chance of a critical hit that does 10% more critical
buffs.notes: Reward from Forgotten Seasons, acquired by reading Turn of the Seasons.

buffs.name: Vampiric Blood Rested
buffs.effect: Increases magic resistance by 10%.
buffs.notes: Acquired if you are a vampire and sleep in a coffin. • The ability is active for 12 hours.

buffs.name: Well Rested
buffs.effect: All skills improve 10% faster for 8 hours.
buffs.notes: Acquired when sleeping in a player home (if you have no spouse or your spouse is not in the same home) or in a rented bed in an inn. Not obtained if you have the Lover's Stone active or are a Werewolf.

buffs.name: Blessing of Akatosh
buffs.effect: Magicka regenerates 10% faster.
buffs.notes: • Regenerate Magicka, 10 pts for 8 hours • Cure Disease, 25 pts

buffs.name: Blessing of Arkay
buffs.effect: Increases your health by 25 points.
buffs.notes: • Fortify Health, 25 pts for 8 hours • Cure Disease, 25 pts

buffs.name: Blessing of Auriel
buffs.effect: You are 10% more effective with missile weapons.
buffs.notes: • Fortify Marksman, 10 pts for 12 hours • Cure Disease, 25 pts

buffs.name: Blessing of Dibella
buffs.effect: +10 Speechcraft.
buffs.notes: • Fortify Persuasion, 10 pts for 8 hours • Cure Disease, 25 pts

buffs.name: Blessing of Julianos
buffs.effect: Increases your Magicka by 25 points.
buffs.notes: • Fortify Magicka, 25 pts for 8 hours • Cure Disease, 25 pts

buffs.name: Blessing of Kynareth
buffs.effect: Increases your stamina by 25 points.
buffs.notes: • Fortify Stamina, 25 pts for 8 hours • Cure Disease, 25 pts

buffs.name: Blessing of Mara
buffs.effect: Healing spells restore 10% more.
buffs.notes: • Fortify Restoration, 10 pts for 8 hours • Cure Disease, 25 pts

buffs.name: Blessing of Nocturnal
buffs.effect: You are 10% harder to detect.
buffs.notes: • Fortify Sneak, 10 pts for 8 hours • Cure Disease, 25 pts

buffs.name: Blessing of Stendarr
buffs.effect: Block 10% more damage with your shield.
buffs.notes: • Fortify Blocking, 10 pts for 8 hours • Cure Disease, 25 pts

buffs.name: Blessing of Talos
buffs.effect: Time between shouts is reduced 20%.
buffs.notes: • Fortify Shouts, 0.2 pts for 8 hours • Cure Disease, 1 pt

buffs.name: Blessing of Zenithar
buffs.effect: Prices are 10% better.
buffs.notes: • Fortify Barter, 10 pts for 8 hours • Cure Disease, 25 pts

buffs.name: Blessing of Azura
buffs.effect: Resist 10% of magic.
buffs.notes: • Resist Magic, 10 pts for 8 hours • Cure Disease, 25 pts

buffs.name: Blessing of Boethiah
buffs.effect: One-handed weapons do 10% more damage.
buffs.notes: • Fortify One-handed, 10 pts for 8 hours • Cure Disease, 25 pts

buffs.name: Blessing of Mephala
buffs.effect: Prices are 10% better.
buffs.notes: • Fortify Barter, 10 pts for 8 hours • Cure Disease, 25 pts

buffs.name: Blessing of Almalexia
buffs.effect: Increases Heavy Armor skill by 10 points. One-handed weapons do 10% more damage.
buffs.notes: • Fortify Heavy Armor, 10 pts for 8 hours • Fortify One-handed, 10% for 8 hours

buffs.name: Blessing of Sotha Sil
buffs.effect: Increases your Magicka by 10 points. Magicka regenerates 5% faster.
buffs.notes: • Fortify Magicka, 10 pts for 8 hours • Regenerate Magicka, 5% for 8 hours

buffs.name: Blessing of Vivec
buffs.effect: Prices are 5% better. You are 5% harder to detect.
buffs.notes: • Fortify Barter, 5% for 8 hours • Fortify Sneak, 5% for 8 hours

buffs.name: Blessing of Vaermina
buffs.effect: Conjuration spells cost 5% less to cast. Illusion spells cost 5% less to cast.
buffs.notes: • Fortify Conjuration, 5% for 8 hours • Fortify Illusion, 5% for 8 hours • Cure Disease, 25 pts

buffs.name: Blessing of the Stag Prince
buffs.effect: Receive an additional x Health and Stamina while Bow of the Stag Prince is equipped.
buffs.notes: Obtained by equipping the Glass Bow of the Stag Prince.

buffs.name: Blood of the Ancients
buffs.effect: Your Vampiric Drain spell absorbs Magicka and Stamina from your victims for 1 days, add max health by 1; Your Vampiric Drain spell absorbs Magicka and Stamina from your victims for 3 days, add max hea
buffs.notes: Drink from the Bloodstone Chalice. Duration increases with each Ancient Power quest completed, to a maximum of 9 days.

buffs.name: Dragonslayer's Blessing
buffs.effect: 10% increased Critical Hit Chance vs. Dragons for 5 days.
buffs.notes: Speaking to Esbern after Alduin's Wall.

buffs.name: Tainted Blood of the Ancients
buffs.effect: Your Vampiric Drain spell absorbs Magicka and Stamina from your victims for 1 day, but at the cost of 30 less health.
buffs.notes: Drink from the Bloodspring.

buffs.name: The Gift of Charity
buffs.effect: +10 Speechcraft for 3600 seconds.
buffs.notes: Giving a coin to a beggar. Giving a gift to your child.

buffs.name: Voice of the Sky
buffs.effect: Animals will neither attack nor flee from you.
buffs.notes: Reading all ten etched tablets on the way leading to High Hrothgar. Effect is removed if you kill a non-hostile animal. Includes your follower, but does not protect your horse from being attacked. Works on vampires but not on trolls, ice wraiths or venomfang s

buffs.name: North Wind
buffs.effect: Targets take 20 points of frost damage for 10 seconds, plus Stamina damage.
buffs.notes: Acquired at the Wind Stone (west-northwest of Skaal Village) once it is cleansed. Single use: activate the stone again to get it back. Works underwater, and all six can be held at once.

buffs.name: Conjure Werebear
buffs.effect: Summons a Werebear for 60 seconds wherever the caster is pointing (120 seconds with the matching Conjuration perk).
buffs.notes: Acquired at the Beast Stone (west of Thirsk Mead Hall) once it is cleansed. Single use: activate the stone again to get it back. Works underwater, and all six can be held at once.

buffs.name: Bones of the Earth
buffs.effect: Caster ignores 80% of all physical damage for 30 seconds.
buffs.notes: Acquired at the Earth Stone (southwest of Raven Rock) once it is cleansed. Single use: activate the stone again to get it back. Works underwater, and all six can be held at once.

buffs.name: Sun Flare
buffs.effect: A 100 point fiery explosion centered on the caster. Does more damage to closer targets.
buffs.notes: Acquired at the Sun Stone (north-northwest of Tel Mithryn) once it is cleansed. Single use: activate the stone again to get it back. Works underwater, and all six can be held at once.

buffs.name: Waters of Life
buffs.effect: Heals everyone close to the caster 200 points.
buffs.notes: Acquired at the Water Stone (north-northwest of Damphall Mine) once it is cleansed. Single use: activate the stone again to get it back. Works underwater, and all six can be held at once.

buffs.name: Root of Power
buffs.effect: All spells cost 75% less to cast for 60 seconds.
buffs.notes: Acquired at the Tree Stone (inside the Temple of Miraak) once it is cleansed. Single use: activate the stone again to get it back. Works underwater, and all six can be held at once.
